import sqlite3,json,urllib.request
BASE="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp"
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags",timeout=5) as r:
 tags={m.get("name") for m in json.load(r).get("models",[])}
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+BASE+"/openwebui-data/webui.db?mode=ro",uri=True); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; c.execute("pragma query_only=on")
rows=c.execute("select id,name,base_model_id,params,is_active,updated_at from model where is_active=1 order by id").fetchall()
out=[]
for r in rows:
 d=dict(r)
 base=d.get("base_model_id")
 is_local=(d["id"] in tags) or (base in tags)
 if not is_local: continue
 try: p=json.loads(d.get("params") or "{}")
 except Exception: p={}
 out.append({"id":d["id"],"name":d["name"],"base_model_id":base,"policy":{"num_ctx":p.get("num_ctx"),"max_tokens":p.get("max_tokens"),"keep_alive":p.get("keep_alive"),"think":p.get("think"),"num_gpu":p.get("num_gpu"),"num_thread":p.get("num_thread"),"use_mlock":p.get("use_mlock"),"use_mmap":p.get("use_mmap")},"updated_at":d["updated_at"]})
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
c.close()
PY
